phase: Development-only Stage1 raw-output decoding screen; no policy-effect or prompt-optimality claim
primary: For each candidate, first raw-response contract validity and request failures on all 96 frozen contexts; do not repair, retry, omit, or stop early. A technical screen reaches 95% at 92/96 or more, but a single screen cannot establish stable superiority.
secondary: Matched per-context discordance, time/anchor/category/JSON failure types, finite propensity, endpoint and event-count diagnostics, unsupported fiscal-policy attribution flags in fiscal OFF arms, finish reason, tokens, latency.
interpretation: Only decoding and representation reliability under v53. Structured output is a distinct protocol, not evidence that the unaided prompt improved. Neither Stage2 purchase realization nor external policy direction/magnitude is assessed. P015 is not run.
